summary:
HF-026 is fixed, including the 8.3 and non-ASCII TEMP shapes that O-001 and O-002 were about. The verdict is partial because review finding m3 (O-003, owed to build-slice) is still open: tests/bugs/SL-076-ScratchKeptPath.Tests.ps1:176 still says "No space in this TEMP, so each line is read whole by either pattern and only the guard decides". That is false twice. Nothing reads the line whole any more and no separate guard decides. The case added five lines below it, 'fsa-rules-sl076 copy', has a space. Only the comment is wrong; the code behaves correctly.

**What was checked at HEAD efab673:**
- **The slice's own test.** It held every check under pwsh 7.6 and under Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100 (Space, TempNotTmp, ShortName, NonAscii, Refused). The Python shape, run with the real harness.py, removed the scratch for all three TEMP spellings.
- **My own probe.** It runs the real harness.py through Invoke-HarnessRaw taken from RuleCases' AST, over 9 TEMP shapes. Eight left no fsa-rules-*: control (spaced), 8.3, non-ASCII, TEMP≠TMP, trailing backslash, forward slashes, TEMP missing, and a CJK name printed as \u escapes. A sibling fsa-rules-sentinel_1 planted in TMP/TEMP survived every run. TMPDIR still leaks; that gap was declared before.
- **The real entry point.** RuleCases -Case All with the real engine took 369 s: 429 ok, 0 FAIL, exit 0, and no new fsa-* in the real %TEMP%. That TEMP has no space and TEMP=TMP, so this only shows the new pattern matches every real "scratch kept" line; it does not exercise the defect.
- **Real entry point with the defect's shape, under Windows PowerShell 5.1.** RuleCases C-006 and C-014, with TMP and TEMP set to different folders under 'John Smith'. Both exited 0 and left no fsa-rules-*.
- **Pre-fix comparison.** The pre-fix RuleCases (14acea3), run on C-014 in the same environment, left fsa-rules-e_8nechq, an 804-file copy of the repo, in TEMP. So the fix is what makes the difference.
- **Other suites.** .NET suite 400/0/0. All 61 fitness rules hold. SL-069 GuardRule and SettledCountProbe GuardRule pass.
- **One failure this slice did not cause.** SL-069-RuleCasesDeriveCounts still fails in its own setup (a CR CR LF here-string makes rules-parity refuse ArchitectureRulesTests.cs:158). The slice's diff touches only RuleCases.ps1 and the new test.

**Slice history.** Build 1, then build 2 (sent back by code review for O-001/O-002, which it then fixed), then review 2, which passed but filed O-003. That is progress, not a loop.

**Cleanup.** All my scratch was removed. The real %TEMP% still holds the same 26 fsa-rules-* folders as before, which I left alone.

checks.what: Slice test, default shapes (stand-in harness), pwsh 7
checks.evidence: All checks held, EXIT=0. Space: removed ...\Users\John Smith\...\fsa-rules-sl076. TempNotTmp: GetTempPath=tmp-a\, and the TEMP (tmp-b) scratch was removed. ShortName: TEMP=...\FS915C~1\Users\JOHNSM~1\... was removed. NonAscii: the line said 'Jos\xe9 Smith' and the real 'José Smith' folder was removed. Refused: elsewhere, not-rules, 'fsa-rules-sl076 copy' and deeper\fsa-rules-sl076 were all left alone.

checks.what: Slice test, default shapes, Windows PowerShell 5.1
checks.evidence: All checks held, EXIT=0. Same checks as under pwsh 7; 8.3 path FS3DB2~1\...\JOHNSM~1.

checks.what: Slice test, Python shape: the real harness.py under the engine's interpreter
checks.evidence: EXIT=0. For all three spellings (spaced TEMP with TMP elsewhere; 8.3 FS221E~1\...\JOHNSM~1; non-ASCII printed as Jos\xe9), harness.py exited 2, said its scratch was in TEMP, and no fsa-rules-* was left in TMP or TEMP.

checks.what: Independent probe: real harness.py and Invoke-HarnessRaw taken from RuleCases' AST, over 9 TEMP shapes, with a sentinel fsa-rules-sentinel_1 planted in TMP/TEMP
checks.evidence: left=0 and sentinels_intact=True for: Control-spaced-long, ShortName (FS5146~1\...\LONGNA~1), NonAscii (Jos\xe9), TempNotTmp (spaced TMP, non-ASCII TEMP), TEMP with a trailing backslash, TEMP with forward slashes, TEMP missing with TMP valid (Python fell back to TMP and the scratch was removed), and a CJK account printed as 张三. TMPDIR set: left=1, the gap the build declared. Sentinels intact means an unrelated fsa-rules-* sibling in TEMP is never removed.

checks.what: RuleCases -Case All against the real engine, with the real %TEMP% compared before and after
checks.evidence: EXIT=0 in 369 s: 445 lines, 429 ok, 0 FAIL, 'All checks held.' No new or removed fsa-* in C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp. Every expected-failure scratch was therefore found by the new leaf pattern in real harness output. This TEMP has TEMP=TMP and no space.

checks.what: Real RuleCases C-006 and C-014 under Windows PowerShell 5.1, with TMP and TEMP set to different spaced folders ('...\John Smith\...\Tmp-A' and '...\Temp-B')
checks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 -Case C-006|C-014 -EnginePython <taad3 venv python> -EngineRoot C:\Users\sshub\projets\taad_v3\backend
checks.evidence: C-006: EXIT=0, 30 ok, 0 FAIL, 34 s. C-014: EXIT=0, 5 ok, 0 FAIL, 21 s. After each, no fsa-rules-* was in TMP or TEMP; only dotnet/NuGet scratch was there. Child PSVersion 5.1.26100.9444.

checks.what: Pre-fix comparison at the real entry point: RuleCases.ps1 from 14acea3 (old pattern with a non-space capture) on C-014, same spaced TEMP≠TMP
checks.command: git show 14acea3:tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 > tests\rules\RuleCases-sl076val-prefix.ps1 (removed in finally); pwsh -File <copy> -Case C-014 ... with TMP/TEMP spaced and different
checks.evidence: The pre-fix copy exited 0 but left fsa-rules-e_8nechq (804 files) in TEMP. The fixed code left none in the same environment. The copy was removed and git status is unchanged.
Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 400, Skipped: 0, Total: 400, Duration: 22 s. EXIT=0
61 rules checked against 113 parsed files. Every declared rule holds.

checks.what: SL-069 derive-counts test, which copies RuleCases into a scratch tree
checks.evidence: EXIT=1 at its own setup (line 96): 'rules-parity: CANNOT-READ tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/ArchitectureRulesTests.cs:158 ... (U+000D)'. This is the same pre-existing CRLF here-string defect attempt 1 recorded. git diff 14acea3..HEAD touches only RuleCases.ps1 and the new SL-076 test, not this test, rules-parity or the .cs file.

checks.what: O-003: is the stale Shape-Refused comment fixed?
checks.evidence: Line 176 still reads '# No space in this TEMP, so each line is read whole by either pattern and only the guard decides.' Line 181 adds the case 'fsa-rules-sl076 copy', which has a space. RuleCases.ps1:177 captures only the leaf and never uses the printed parent, so no guard decides on a read path.
26 fsa-rules-* before and after, the same pre-existing set, left untouched. No fsa-sl076* or fsa-sl076val2-* folder is left. git status shows only the engine's .taad files.

criteria.criterion: HF-026: Invoke-HarnessRaw reads the harness's 'scratch kept at' line so that a %TEMP% with a space is not cut at the space, and the expected-failure scratch copy is removed
criteria.how: RuleCases.ps1:177 uses '(?m)^harness: scratch kept at .*[\\/](fsa-rules-[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*$'. Checked with the Space shape (stand-in, pwsh 7 and 5.1), the Python shape and my probe with the real harness.py (left=0), and real RuleCases C-006/C-014 under 5.1 with a spaced TEMP (none left). The pre-fix RuleCases left an 804-file fsa-rules-e_8nechq in the same environment.

criteria.criterion: HF-026: when TEMP and TMP differ, the folder Python's mkdtemp made in TEMP is still removed
criteria.how: RuleCases.ps1:179 looks up the leaf in both GetTempPath() and $env:TEMP. In the TempNotTmp shape GetTempPath returned tmp-a\ and the tmp-b scratch was removed. In the Python shape, my TempNotTmp probe and real C-014 with TMP≠TEMP, no fsa-rules-* was left.

criteria.criterion: Accepted review elaboration (O-001/O-002): an 8.3 short-name TEMP and a non-ASCII account name, which say() escapes, are also cleaned
criteria.how: The ShortName and NonAscii shapes pass under pwsh 7 and 5.1, and the Python shape passes with the real harness.py. My probe also passed ShortName, NonAscii and a CJK name printed as \u escapes (left=0 each).

criteria.criterion: Only a folder named as mkdtemp names it, directly in TMP or TEMP, is ever removed
criteria.how: The Refused shape passes 4 cases: elsewhere, not-rules, 'fsa-rules-sl076 copy', deeper\fsa-rules-sl076. In all 9 probe runs a planted sibling fsa-rules-sentinel_1 in TMP/TEMP survived.

criteria.criterion: No regression in the suites the change touches (validated by the project's full test suite)
criteria.how: RuleCases -Case All with the real engine: 429 ok, 0 FAIL, exit 0. .NET 400/0/0. Fitness 61/61. SL-069 GuardRule and SettledCountProbe GuardRule pass. SL-069-RuleCasesDeriveCounts fails at its own CRLF setup; it was already failing and the slice did not touch it.

obligations.evidence: Owed to build-slice and not done. At HEAD efab673, tests/bugs/SL-076-ScratchKeptPath.Tests.ps1:176 still says '# No space in this TEMP, so each line is read whole by either pattern and only the guard decides.' Nothing reads the line whole any more (RuleCases.ps1:177 captures only the leaf) and no guard decides on a read path. The case at :181, 'fsa-rules-sl076 copy', has a space. Build-slice has had no attempt since review 2 filed this, and git status shows no change to the file. The review's suggested rewording is still to be applied.

The ShortName shape passes under pwsh 7 and 5.1. In the Python shape the real harness.py printed TEMP as FS221E~1\...\JOHNSM~1 and nothing was left. My probe's ShortName (FS5146~1\...\LONGNA~1) left 0.
The NonAscii shape passes under pwsh 7 and 5.1. In the Python shape the real harness.py printed 'Jos\xe9 Smith' and nothing was left. My probe's NonAscii and CJK (张三) shapes left 0.

not_reached: A real Windows account whose profile path has a space or a non-ASCII letter, where Windows itself sets TEMP/TMP. Every such shape was simulated by setting TEMP/TMP in a child process on the sshub account, whose own TEMP=TMP=C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp.
Whether Windows 11 26200 actually gives TEMP an 8.3 short form for a long or spaced account name. The 8.3 shape used a FileSystemObject ShortPath of a folder made here.
A real MSYS/Git Bash shell exporting TMPDIR. Simulated with the env var, and it still leaks (left=1): the gap the build declared, which the fix does not claim to cover.
RuleCases -Case All under Windows PowerShell 5.1. Only C-006 and C-014 were run under 5.1; -Case All ran under pwsh 7.6.

RuleCases C-006 passing on a machine whose GetTempPath is non-ASCII. The build measured 4 failing 'engine root <path>' expectations there, a separate expectation defect it declared, and I did not re-run it.
What left the 26 pre-existing fsa-rules-* folders in this machine's %TEMP%. They were there before this slice and are unchanged by it; not attributed, not deleted.
